title: Data Engineer GCP
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are Seeking a "Data Engineer" to build, optimize, and maintain the modern data platform within a cloud environment.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Work experience on relational l & non-relational databases platform
  • Design, build, and maintain robust and scalable data pipelines for batch and real-time processing, from ingestion to final consumption.
  • Construct and manage the data lake infrastructure (multi-cloud), ensuring governance, security, and scalability.
  • Administer and optimize various database management systems (DBMS) , including relational and NoSQL databases.
  • Implement real-time data stream processing solutions using technologies like Apache Kafka or similar.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions.
  • Ensure data quality, observability, and reliability through testing, monitoring, and pipeline versioning.
  • Implement and enforce data security and privacy policies.
  • Automate repetitive data engineering and management tasks, applying DevOps and CI/CD principles.
  • Proven experience in data engineering, focusing on both batch and streaming pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with modern data platforms and orchestration tools (e.g., Apache Spark, Airflow, Databricks).
  • Deep knowledge of GCP cloud environments and data-related services.
  • Proficiency in SQL and experience with both relational and non-relational databases.
  • Experience with data streaming technologies such as Apache Kafka or managed cloud services.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, Scala, or Java.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible) is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.



What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Assistente de Folha de Pagamento (DP)
description:
Descrição da Empresa

A ContabilizaEcom é uma empresa de contabilidade especialmente voltada para o e‑commerce, que combina expertise fiscal, tributária e empresarial para apoiar lojas online no Brasil.

Alguns destaques da empresa:

  • Foi criada por quem “nasceu em um e‑commerce”, ou seja, compreende os desafios práticos desse tipo de negócio.
  • Oferece serviços como abertura de empresa, análise fiscal de produtos, configuração de ERP e canais de venda, recuperação de impostos pagos indevidamente, planejamento tributário e busca de benefícios fiscais.
  • Foca em economia de impostos, segurança jurídica e regularização fiscal dos seus clientes.
  • Tem métricas que demonstram credibilidade: mais de 300 sellers ativos, cerca de 96% de satisfação dos clientes e mais de R$ 10 milhões em impostos economizados.


Sobre a Vaga:

Estamos procurando um Assistente de Folha de Pagamento (DP) para se juntar à equipe da ContabilizaEcom em Curitiba. Este cargo envolve a execução de tarefas diárias relacionadas a folha de pagamento no setor de departamento pessoal que busque a garantia de conformidade com as leis trabalhistas e legais vigentes.


Este é um cargo de tempo integral presencial, permitindo algumas atividades administrativas realizadas remotamente, onde o colaborador tem espaço para o crescimento em um ambiente descontraído com limites e responsabilidades.


Qualificações acadêmicas esperadas e atribuições da função


  • Formação: Graduação cursando ou completa em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, RH ou áreas correlatas.
  • Processamento da Folha: Executar o cálculo mensal da folha de pagamento, garantindo a exatidão de salários, descontos e proventos.
  • Cálculo de Encargos: Calcular e conferir o INSS, FGTS e IRRF.
  • Fechamento e Conferência: Realizar o fechamento da folha e emitir os relatórios de conferência (holerites), assegurando a conformidade legal.
  • Emissão de Guias: Gerar e enviar as guias de recolhimento dos encargos sociais e impostos (Ex: DAF, GPS/DARF Previdenciário).
  • Rotinas de Pessoal: executar cálculo e registro de férias e processamento de rescisões contratuais, com o devido registro no sistema.
  • Obrigações Acessórias: Realizar o lançamento e acompanhamento dos eventos mensais e periódicos no eSocial, garantindo a qualidade e o envio das informações.
  • Atendimento: Prestar suporte e esclarecimento de dúvidas aos colaboradores sobre holerites, benefícios e questões trabalhistas básicas.


Competências Comportamentais


  • Organização.
  • Habilidades de análise.
  • Proatividade.


Remuneração:

  • Salário a combinar (enviar pretensão salarial no currículo)
  • Vale transporte

  • Vale alimentação
  • Vale transporte
  • Plano de saúde
  • Plano odontológico
  • Plano de carreira

title: Gerente de Manutenção
description:
Procurando um desafio?


Seja em terra ou no mar, você encontra esse desafio na Edison Chouest Offshore. Somos uma família de empresas voltadas para resultados e apaixonadas pela excelência. Estamos orgulhosos do mosaico de pessoas que nos torna o fornecedor líder mundial de serviços marítimos.

Desde a chegada da primeira embarcação do Grupo Chouest, em 1991, a frota em operação no Brasil vem aumentando, já contando com mais de 70 embarcações altamente especializadas, de última geração.



Quer se juntar a nós e fazer parte do time de Manutenção?

· Conhecimento e experiência em Gestão de Pessoas.

· Previdência Privada;

· Benefício de Academias e Plataforma de incentivo a rotina saudável.

title: Lower School Makerspace Teacher
description:
EARJ is looking for an experienced and accomplished Lower School Makerspace Teacher to join our team at Gávea campus (July 2026).

The Lower School Makerspace Teacher is a dynamic and innovative educator who fosters creativity, collaboration, critical thinking, and problem-solving through hands-on STEM learning experiences.   • A skillful and creative practitioner in multilingual and interdisciplinary classrooms.
  • A motivated learner who takes responsibility for their own professional growth.
  • Someone who thrives in an environment of transformational leadership.
  • Passionate about innovation, creativity, and hands-on, inquiry-based learning.
  • Skilled in high-impact 21st-century instructional practices, integrating technology, design thinking, and the arts.
  • And, most importantly, teaches students, not just subjects.

If you are culturally open-minded and have an optimistic growth mindset, then EARJ is the place where you can make a difference. Join a community that is inclusive, culturally sensitive, and equitable, where everyone experiences a strong sense of belonging.

title: Executivo de Vendas Externa - Mercado Pago
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!


Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.


Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.


Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.


Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.


Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora, são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • Primam pela excelência na execução como forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem um ambiente inclusivo e um bom clima tanto para as pessoas que trabalham no Meli como para o negócio.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.


Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Representar o Mercado Pago em uma Região: percorrer áreas comerciais (loja a loja), identificar oportunidades, entender as necessidades dos lojistas e oferecer soluções personalizadas com os produtos e serviços do Mercado Pago (foco em maquininha de cartão).
  • Prospectar de forma estratégica: realizar abordagens porta a porta, 100% presenciais, com planejamento, disciplina e eficiência, superando metas e maximizando a satisfação das empresas credenciadas.
  • Garantir um excelente pós-venda: acompanhar o onboarding das empresas credenciadas, garantindo a ativação imediata, engajamento e principalidade de relacionamento com o Mercado Pago.
  • Competir em Equipe para Ganhar: participar ativamente das reuniões e demais atividades em equipe, compartilhando boas práticas, ideias inovadoras, contribuindo para a maximização dos resultados individuais

O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

Brasicon Consórcios Personalizados Ltda.


Vendedor Consorcio e Plano de Saúde


Formação e Conhecimento

• Maior de 18 anos

• Ensino médio completo;

• Conhecimento em produtos de consórcio e/ou plano de saúde.

• Noções de legislação e regulamentação de consórcios e/ou plano de saúde.

• Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM e softwares de gestão de vendas.

• Capacidade de elaborar propostas comerciais e simulações.


Experiência

• Experiência prévia em vendas externas ou internas, preferencialmente em produtos financeiros, serviços de longo prazo, como planos de saúde.

• Histórico comprovado de metas atingidas e resultados consistentes.

• Experiência em atendimento ao cliente e pós-venda.


Habilidades Técnicas

• Capacidade de prospectar clientes e identificar oportunidades de negócio.

• Habilidade em negociação e fechamento de vendas.

• Boa comunicação verbal e escrita.

• Organização para gerenciar carteira de clientes e follow-ups.

• Conhecimento em marketing digital e redes sociais é um diferencial.


Perfil Comportamental

• Proatividade e iniciativa para buscar clientes e soluções.

• Persistência e resiliência diante de objeções ou dificuldades.

• Ética e transparência na condução do processo de venda.

• Capacidade de trabalhar com metas e pressão de resultados.

• Empatia e habilidade de ouvir o cliente para entender suas necessidades.

• Trabalho em equipe: capacidade de colaborar com colegas, compartilhar informações e contribuir para metas coletivas.

• Autonomia e disciplina para organizar a rotina de vendas.


Características Pessoais

• Perfil motivado por resultados e desafios.

• Facilidade em criar relacionamento de confiança com clientes.

• Adaptabilidade para lidar com diferentes perfis de clientes e mudanças de mercado.

description:

Aqui você tem oportunidades sob medida para umas verdadeiras evoluções na sua carreira.

title: Service Technician
description:
Working Location: Dona Francisca Street, number 8300, complement block O3, ZIP , North industrial district, Joinville, Santa Catarina, Brazil


Responsibility:

  1. Participate in various training organized by technical service department to improve technical ability and comprehensive service ability.
  2. Responsible for the plan suggestion or formulation of subsidiary stock spare parts.
  3. Submit the summary of machine quality problems in the responsible area and put forward suggestions for machine quality improvement.
  4. Responsible for assisting other colleagues of the subsidiary to complete the on-site inventory of spare parts warehouse of the subsidiary.
  5. Follow all company and customer safety policies.
  6. Install, repair, and maintain Injection Molding Machinery, linear robot, hopper dryer, auto-load, chiller, and related software, and control systems.
  7. Perform all safety checks on the equipment.
  8. Follow all of the company's procedures.
  9. Demonstrate the use of the equipment, and provide customer training.
  10. Troubleshoot machine failures and performance issues (Define service problem, collect data, establish facts, draw valid conclusions) and perform root cause analysis, and corrective actions. Document findings and actions.
  11. Order replacement parts as required and document other worn parts which may need replaced in the future.
  12. Respond quickly to customer problems via phone, email, or onsite in a prompt, courteous and professional way.
  13. Provide maintenance and operation recommendations or on-site service to customers.
  14. Provide written reports on all service calls, making sure to document key contacts, and the workload of the machines.
  15. Provide after-sales service and technical training for customers and agents, including but not limited to equipment safety, operation, maintenance, plastic raw materials and molding process training.
  16. Translate service files into local languages if necessary.


Requirements:

1.Education:

- College or bachelor degree;

- Major in mechanical manufacturing, electric engineering, automation or plastic material or equal;

- Other education background but more than 3 years’ experience in injection molding machine design, after-sales service or maintenance.

2.Background：

- 2 years service work or technical support work experience in injection molding machine industry or related industry.

3.Abilities：

- Ability to communicate in English;

- Ability to drive car;

- Extensive knowledge in the trouble shooting and repairing of injection molding machines, covering all aspects including controls, mechanical, hydraulic and electrical systems;

- Ability to use computers, email systems, basic Microsoft Office Excel, Word and Powerpoint;

- Ability to understand mechanical drawings, electrical and hydraulic schematics.

title: Project Finance Analyst
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Financeiro de Projetos Sênior para atuar como braço direito da liderança técnica, acompanhando todo o ciclo de vida dos projetos. Este(a) profissional será responsável por análises financeiras (CAPEX e OPEX), gestão de portfólio e reporte de resultados, apoiando a tomada de decisão estratégica com foco em eficiência, redução de custos e melhorias contínuas.


Responsabilidades:

• Apoiar a líder técnica na gestão financeira de projetos.

• Realizar cálculo e monitoramento de benefícios de projetos.

• Realizar o cálculo de viabilidade financeira de projetos (Business Case).

• Acompanhar o ciclo de vida dos projetos do início ao fim.

• Realizar análises financeiras, incluindo CAPEX e OPEX.

• Produzir relatórios financeiros e repasses periódicos à liderança.

• Avaliar e sugerir melhorias em processos, identificando oportunidades de redução de custos.

• Apoiar a disseminação da metodologia de projetos na diretoria.

• Gerir o portfólio de projetos sob a ótica financeira.

• Participar de reuniões e apresentações para a liderança.


Requisitos (Hard Skills):

• Experiência em gestão financeira de projetos (CAPEX e OPEX).

• Vivência em gestão de portfólio de projetos (PMO).

• Experiência em apresentações executivas.

• Inglês intermediário (leitura, escrita de relatórios e comunicação em reuniões).

• Sólido conhecimento em análises financeiras e elaboração de reportes.


Competências (Soft Skills):

• Perfil comprometido e organizado.

• Postura profissional, ética e detalhista.

• Boa capacidade de comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal.

• Habilidade política para navegação em diferentes cenários.

• Capacidade de se posicionar e propor soluções.

• Autonomia na gestão das próprias atividades, com capacidade de organização, priorização e entrega com qualidade.


Diferenciais:

• Conhecimento em Power BI.

• Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão de projetos (Pharos).

• Histórico de atuação como apoio direto a lideranças técnicas em projetos estratégicos.


REMUNERAÇÃO e BENEFÍCIOS:

• Contrato CLT por tempo indeterminado.

• Refeição no local.

• Plano de saúde.

• Seguro de vida.

• Horário: 2ª a 6ª das 08:00 às 17:30.

• Local: Curitiba-PR

title: Desenvolvimento Salesforce/OmniStudio / APEX / Trigger Sênior - 125557
description:
Sobre a vaga


Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que estamos buscando?


Desenvolvimento Salesforce Sênior


Requisitos:

Experiência comprovada na plataforma Salesforce como desenvolvedor, indicando uma compreensão sólida das práticas e padrões da plataforma. 2. Arquitetura e Integrações: • Desenvolvimento de soluções e integrações com trocas de dados entre o Salesforce e sistemas legados. • Conhecimento profundo das ferramentas de carga de dados, como Dataloader , para facilitar a integração eficiente entre o Salesforce e o banco de dados legado. 3. Análise de Impacto: • Capacidade de avaliar o impacto de novos requisitos no Salesforce, bem como em todas as aplicações, sistemas e processos relacionados. 4. Conhecimento Especializado: • Domínio das melhores práticas, funcionalidades e limitações do Salesforce, garantindo a implementação eficaz e eficiente das soluções. 5. Habilidades Técnicas: • Proficiência em Salesforce Lightning, APEX, Trigger e App Builde r, com experiência prática no desenvolvimento de soluções personalizadas, além dos aceleradores do pacote de OmniStudio (Integration Procedure, Omni Script, Data Mapper e Flex Card 6. Controle de Versão: • Familiaridade com o controle de versão usando Git, facilitando a colaboração e o gerenciamento de código entre a equipe de desenvolvimento. 7. Modelagem de Fluxos de Negócio: • Capacidade de modelar fluxos de negócio para traduzir requisitos de negócio em soluções técnicas eficazes dentro do Salesforce. 8. Metodologias Ágeis: • Conhecimentos avançados em metodologias ágeis, permitindo uma abordagem iterativa e colaborativa no desenvolvimento de soluções Salesforce.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Experiência com OmniStudio, aplicando aceleradores prontos para uso e personalizando-os para as necessidades da indústria de energia e serviços públicos;
  • Conhecimento em Business Rule Engine (BRE) para otimização de regras de negócios e processos de precificação complexos;
  • Experiência com Orchestration Management (OM), incluindo decomposição de pedidos e desenvolvimento de planos de orquestração para processos complexos e multi-step;
  • Conhecimento em Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) será considerado um diferencial, especialmente para gerenciar contratos ao longo de seu ciclo de vida, da criação à renovação e fechamento;


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.


O que oferecemos:


Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;

Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;

Programas de incentivo à Certificações;

Horário de trabalho flexível;

Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;

Salários competitivos;

Avaliação de desempenho anual com possibilidade de bonificação;

Gympass;

Previdência Privada;

Auxílio-Creche;

Assistência Médica;

Assistência Odontológica;

Seguro de Vida.


Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

title: Business Intelligence Partner
description:
Business Intelligence Partner

Location: Sao Paulo Brazil


about Randstad Enterprise

Randstad Sourceright is a global talent leader, providing solutions and expertise that help companies position for growth, execute on strategy, and improve business agility. Our experience encompasses all facets of the talent acquisition of permanent employees and the contingent and contractor workforce. Key offerings include Managed Services Provider (MSP) programs, Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO), and Blended Workforce Solutions. Randstad Sourceright offers solutions Globally in North America, EMEA, and APAC. Working for a multi-country organization means working with clients and colleagues from different backgrounds. This results in a digital way of working and requires a proactive and culturally inclusive mindset.


job context

and purpose


Purpose of the job

This role aims to partner with the Regional and global BI customers within RSR (who can include but are not limited to Data engineering, BI Support Teams, Operational Teams, Internal teams, and RSR clients) and provide business solutions through data.

This position has operational and technical responsibility for reporting, analytics, and visualization dashboards across all operating companies within RSR. This position will develop processes and strategies to consolidate, automate, and improve reporting and dashboards for external clients and internal stakeholders.

As a Business Intelligence Partner, you will oversee the end-to-end delivery of regional and global account and client BI reporting. This will include working with data engineering to provide usable datasets, creating dashboards with meaningful insights & visualizations within our BI solution, and ongoing communication and partnering with the ‘BI consumers. Must be knowledgeable in Tableau and SQL. The key to this is that as a Business Intelligence Partner, you will be a commercial and operational expert who can translate data into insights. You will use this to mitigate risk, find operational and revenue-generating opportunities, and provide business solutions.


Key stakeholders

  • RSR internal stakeholders include but are not limited to C-Suite, Finance, Regional Managing Directors, Vice Presidents, and operational account leaders.
  • RSR external clients


Position Summary

Development of BI solutions (50%):

  • Responsible for delivering BI solutions for the program
  • Responsible for ensuring all contractual conditions around reporting, financial elements, SLA's, and KPI's are reviewed, understood, and adhered to
  • Assess operating reality to validate solution requirements and adjust as needed.
  • Implement and reinforce tools, including standards, procedures, and documentation.
  • Ensure the team has living documentation on reporting requirements, data processes, and other program-specific content.
  • Oversee the design and build of insightful, scalable, and actionable visualizations.
  • Develop, document, and maintain a comprehensive quality management program
  • Build, implement, and schedule production standards of files and reports to ensure accuracy and timeliness.
  • Ensure reporting quality and accuracy by evaluating, integrating, and complementing data sources.
  • Execute continuous process improvement process.
  • Knowledge of general database functions, data storage, data models, SQL, and data transfer protocols

Consult (30%):

  • Responsible for being the liaison between the external client, operations teams and the wider BI teams
  • Using client data and insights to highlight and provide observations, provide recommendations, and contribute to ongoing business discussions and decision-making.
  • Analyze the client’s data to present the account leadership and client with potential approaches or opportunities for improving service delivery performance and elevating value-added opportunities.
  • Have commercial awareness and work with the account leadership to maximize revenue-generating opportunities.
  • Solicit feedback from internal and external stakeholders in an organized manner to contribute to the objectives of the BI team and demonstrate RSR value.
  • Contribute to the success of a wider global team.
  • Qualify the business needs of each request and use expertise to partner on solutions.
  • Develop strong working relationships with the client stakeholders and account leads.
  • Serve as a functional and technical data visualization and business intelligence subject matter expert.

Maintain Standards (20%):

  • Work within the agreed parameters aligned to the global method of BI production
  • Leverage an agile work environment to incorporate new innovative and value components into existing portfolios
  • Organize a feedback standard from stakeholders (internal and external) in order to create use case, case study materials and other customer-facing material
  • Promote available resources and enterprise tools for operations training/ coaching needs from a BI perspective.
  • Ensure data governance principles and guidelines are being met


job

Requirements

Please share your resume in English .

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree a plus

Mandatory Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in a similar role
  • Project Management and/or process improvement experience
  • MI/Business Intelligence/Data Science/Analytics background
  • Proficient with an ANSI-compliant SQL dialect
  • Proven experience with Tableau dashboard development
  • Ability to turn ambiguous information and unstructured challenges into substantive insights.

Preferred Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in a similar role
  • Industry exposure to business process outsourcing and/or workforce planning (e.g., MSP/RPO)

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills required for various levels throughout external and internal organizations
  • Excellent presentation skills used in delivering solutions to executive-level clients
  • Demonstrated continuous improvement, process documentation, and workflow skills
  • Excellent working knowledge of MS - Excel with knowledge of macros and pivot tables.
  • Excellent working knowledge of Google products, and visualization tools Tableau, etc.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects, tasks, and meet deadlines while maintaining quality
  • Ability to synthesize and analyze information and ideas
  • Strong drive and commitment to delivering outstanding results
  • Have the ability to provide value with the use of analytics to help achieve the account’s objectives and the client’s initiatives.
  • Ability to create meaningful insights and metrics that aligned to business priorities and objectives
  • Data visualization preferred; ability to interpret data and translate it to non-tech people.
  • Proven experience with Tableau dashboard development
  • Ability to write Intermediate SQL scripts
  • Experience in data pipeline creation, quality improvement and analysis to provide teams with actionable insights, informing strategy, impact and investments.
  • Experience with analytics tools.
  • Extensive experience in technical client service (i.e. consulting experience).
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills with attention to detail and a well-organized, structured approach to work.
  • Must be fluent in English.


This position will require a live SQL Assessment.

title: Junior Registration Analyst
description:
Syndigo powers the continual flow of data and content throughout the entire commerce ecosystem— accelerating delivery of accurate and compelling information that increases sales on every shelf. We are the recognized leader in software and services for the management of master data, product information, digital assets, and content syndication and analytics across industries including grocery, foodservice, hardlines, home improvement, oil & gas, pet, health and beauty, automotive, apparel, and healthcare products.

Syndigo serves the industry’s largest two-sided network, connecting more than 50,000 global users across 12,000+ global brands with more than 1,750 global retailers.

Basically, we're the people that deliver the rich, accurate product content that helps consumers shop online with confidence, and helps brands and retailers operate efficient product supply chains. We cannot do all of this without our amazing employees who make the magic happen here at Syndigo. As we continue to grow, we’re always looking to identify talented individuals to join our team.

***Candidate Must Be Located in Joinville, Santa Catarina***

As a Junior Registration Analyst at  Syndigo ,  you’ll  play a key role in ensuring product information is  accurate , complete, and ready for approval. This position is perfect for detail-oriented individuals who enjoy working with data and supporting quality processes.

HOW WE’LL BE WINNING TOGETHER DAY TO DAY

  • Review and interpret product packaging information and enter it into our technology platform
  • Ensure all data follows predefined guidelines and models
  • Audit content created by team members and third-party contributors for accuracy
  • Validate and correct information before manufacturer approval
  • Communicate with customers to provide guidance and request approval of  finalized content

WE SHOULD TALK IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU 

  • Completed secondary education  required ; higher education (in progress or completed) is a plus
  • Technical Skills: Comfortable with Windows systems and Microsoft Office tools
  • Soft Skills: Strong attention to detail, ability to follow structured processes, and clear communication skills
  • Experience:  No prior experience  required — we’ll  provide training!
  • Ability to work in-person at our Joinville office, 5 days a week.
Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

To achieve the best version of our organization, we know it takes new ideas, new approaches, new perspectives and new ways of thinking. A purpose we are 100% committed to cultivating.

Diversity is woven into our fabric at Syndigo and it’s how we stay an industry leader, innovating technology solutions that equip our customers with everything they need to be successful! 

All are welcome here and we invite you to join our team if you are ready to help us continue that growth!

title: Coordenador fiscal - Torre de faturamento
description:
Briefing da posição:


Como Coordenador/Supervisor Fiscal da Torre de Faturamento, o profissional será responsável por liderar a operação fiscal vinculada ao faturamento da empresa (“torre” de faturamento), assegurando o correto processamento de notas fiscais, apuração de tributos diretos e indiretos, cumprimento de obrigações acessórias, e a entrega de resultados por meio de KPIs.


Espera-se perfil de liderança, domínio técnico e capacidade de interface executiva (internamente com Financeiro, Faturamento, Contabilidade, Comercial, e externamente com clientes). O inglês avançado será requisito para interação com equipes globais ou clientes internacionais.


Principais responsabilidades:


  • Coordenar as atividades da torre de faturamento: emissão e conferência de notas fiscais (saídas/entradas), conferência de faturamento, retenções, XML, NFS-e/NF-e, CTe, etc.
  • Garantir o cumprimento de obrigações acessórias: SPED Fiscal, SPED Contribuições, DCTF, EFD-Contribuições, REINF, ECF/ECD, etc;
  • Implantar e monitorar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) da operação fiscal/faturamento (por exemplo: % de notas com erro fiscal, tempo de processamento, custo por nota, índice de credits fiscais aproveitados, SLA de faturamento, conformidade) e reportar à liderança executiva;
  • Desenvolver e liderar a equipe da torre (coordenados e analistas), promovendo treinamento, engajamento, definição de metas, monitoramento de performance e melhorias contínuas de processo;
  • Interface com Financeiro, Contabilidade, Comercial/Vendas, TI/ERP e auditoria, assegurando que as operações de faturamento estejam alinhadas aos controles internos, aos requisitos de compliance e às estratégias de negócio;
  • Liderar ou participar de iniciativas de melhoria de processos, automação, mapeamento de riscos fiscais, aproveitamento de créditos, e adaptação a mudanças da legislação (como reforma tributária, por exemplo) ou cenários de negócio;
  • Apresentar análises gerenciais e relatórios executivos (em inglês, quando for o caso) à alta direção ou matriz, com propostas de ação, acompanhamento de metas e suportes decisórios.


Qualificações & requisitos:


  • Formação superior em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Preferencialmente com registro CRC ativo (quando aplicável);
  • Experiência sólida em operação fiscal/tributária, com apuração de tributos diretos e indiretos em ambiente corporativo;
  • Experiência comprovada em faturamento ou faturamento tributário (emissão de notas fiscais, retenções, faturamento em operação com produtos/serviços) e liderança de equipe;
  • Inglês avançado (oral e escrito) – para reportes, interface com clientes estrangeiros;
  • Perfil forte de liderança, com habilidades executivas — comunicação clara, capacidade de influenciar, visibilidade junto à diretoria, visão de negócio;
  • Familiaridade com KPIs, dashboards, relatórios gerenciais, e métricas de performance da área fiscal/faturamento;
  • Atuação em ambiente de alta demanda, com foco em prazos, entregas, auditorias e mudanças regulatórias;


Competências comportamentais:


  • Visão estratégica com mindset operacional (“hands-on”);
  • Alta capacidade analítica e atenção a detalhes;
  • Orientação para resultados e melhoria contínua;
  • Excelente comunicação (com a equipe, stakeholders e diretoria);
  • Adaptabilidade e proatividade para lidar com mudanças rápidas (ex: reforma tributária, nova legislação);
  • Integridade, postura ética e foco em compliance;


Se você é um líder fiscal com visão estratégica, domínio técnico e capacidade de transformar operações através de performance, governança e indicadores, esta posição pode ser a oportunidade ideal para direcionar resultados com impacto direto no negócio.

title: Inspetor de qualidade

• Comunicação clara e objetiva.

Como se candidatar:

O termo Conforme + Dominante vem do teste comportamental DISC , que classifica o comportamento das pessoas em quatro perfis principais:

  • D – Dominância
  • I – Influência
  • S – Estabilidade
  • C – Conformidade

No caso, “Conforme + Dominante ” significa que a pessoa tem predominância nas características de Conformidade (C) , mas também apresenta traços de Dominância (D) .

Isso gera um perfil que normalmente é:

Conforme (C) – Característica principal

  • Extremamente organizada
  • Segue processos e padrões
  • Atenta a detalhes
  • Gosta de fazer certo da primeira vez
  • Preocupada com qualidade e precisão

Dominante (D) – Característica secundária

  • Decidida e assertiva
  • Focada em resultados
  • Não tem medo de assumir responsabilidades
  • Capaz de tomar decisões rápidas
  • Sabe cobrar e manter prazos

title: Senior Murex Integration Specialist (S4C)
description:
Project Description:

Luxoft has one of the world's leading Murex practices. We are a top-tier Murex Alliance Partner and a market leader in implementation, integration, upgrade and migration. We provide end-to end project services and have delivered over 200 successful Murex projects across all major asset-classes and sectors including investment banking, asset management, corporate treasury and insurance.


Whether you possess a background in finance, technology or Mathematics, your experience in the capital markets industry would be of high interest to us.


Responsibilities:

- Must know the following technologies: MxMLExchange, RTBS/MDCS, Datamart

- Knowledge and hands on experience in implementing, developing and supporting various MX.3 proprietary modules for Enterprise Integration such as MxML Exchange, Datamart, MX.3 Accessibility and Extensibility APIs (.Net, Java, C++, and SOAP/REST Web services), Real-time bridging service, Market Data Cache Server, MX.3 Connectivity 2.0 framework, MX.3 Packaged interfaces including (but not limited to) MarkitWire, DTCC Global Trade Repository, MarginSphere, IceLink, FXAll, Market Data Import Tool etc., MX.3 End of Day processes and Trade Life Cycle Management using workflows engine. (At least 3 years)

- Build new up / down stream integration(s)

- Convert existing integration point with Murex version change

- Development of MxML (Workflows, Exchange)

- XSL / Transformation

- Scripting (bsh, ksh, ...etc.)

- Assist existing support group(s) in resolving integration related request or issues

- Contribute to overall solutions as per project deliverables

- Perform various levels of testing for assigned deliverables as well as participate in formal release cycles (SIT/UAT)

- Liaise with technical team(s) -- when needed -- to resolve environment related issues and necessary enhancements in preparation for cloud deployment

- Analyze, formulate, proposed, develop and/or contribute to overall solutions as per project deliverables

- Perform various levels of testing for assigned deliverables as well as participate in formal release cycles (SIT/UAT)


1. Provide professional services to Murex clients:

o Provide services in the domain of system integration, business intelligence and data flows through the full lifecycle of the MX.3: requirements analysis, configuration build, installation, training, upgrade, and production support.

o Professionally interact with Murex colleagues and clients.

2. Build, test, and provide support to clients on MX.3 integration modules.

o Contribute to project implementations

 Participate in design, build, and test phases sometimes remotely and other times at the client site as needed.

 Develop trade workflows and interfaces to set up communication between external platforms and murex to receive trade and other data feeds, process them, save into the system, and send acknowledgement. Use a combination of MXMLExchange, MXopenconnect, Murex APIs, and Datamart to successfully deliver such solutions.

 Contribute to functional documentation of the test cases and use cases by the client.

 Contribute to Design documentation for the Build process of the Product.

 Develop and maintain end-to-end configuration management packages etc. Install, Deploy and test Murex packaged interfaces like MDIT (market data interface tool), Markitwire, BSMT and MarkitCredit to receive live and end-of-day data from external providers like Bloomberg, Reuters, Markit, etc.

o Handle support cases from notification to resolution and validation.

• Participate in the business as usual and project support: follow-up of client open cases through email, CRM portal, phone-calls and on-site visits

• Develop an understanding of ongoing activities and manage own deliverables / progress

• Manage bug fixes and enhancements with the Product Team

3. Integrate with various teams to deliver the right solution to client.

o Work with S4C stream leads, Front-Office, Back-Office, or Risk teams to understand requirements and develop solutions for the client.

o Work with the Product division team to provide them timely details on defects - how to reproduce the issue, project/client constraints, and how to validate the fix.

o Follow up with the S4C stream leads, the Project Manager, and other teams to meet deadlines and regular meetings to make sure the delivery is on time.

4. Work with technologies including SQL, Unix, and Murex proprietary standards like Murex Scripting Language (MSL), XMLF, etc. for client solutions.

o Use SQL for end-of-day report generation, STP (straight through processing) failure issues, P&L evaluation, for analyzing issues in trade feed and status Etc.

o Java programming skills are not essential but are a plus.

o Various Murex proprietary languages and formats: Data Query Language for querying in various screens in MX.3, MSL (Murex Scripting Language) for pre-trade logic, XMLF for post-trade flow processing, MxML in various contexts, etc.

o Create shell/python scripts for automation of day-to-day manual activities.


Understand requirements, analyze the problem areas of the current system and behavior of pre- trade and post-trade workflow, and integration points.


Mandatory Skills Description:

Must:

- 4+ years experience with Murex Datamart and workflows

- Must know any 2 of the following technologies: MxMLExchange, RTBS/MDCS, Datamart, C2.0 Product interfaces

- SQL; XML; MxML; UNIX; Scripting languages

- Hands on experience with Murex MxML Exchange development

- Knowledge of pre trade framework along with MSL scripting language

- Strong Knowledge of SQL/RDBMS technology

- Knowledge of XML/JSON and related technologies (XSLT), Java/J2EE, Python, or C/C++ or C#, and scripting languages such as UNIX Shell or JavaScript, Jenkins, CI/CD, DevOps, Maven, Git/Bitbucket, Apache Camel, ESB, ETL

- Familiarity with UNIX/Linux operating systems


- Must have strong personality, logical and analytical skills

- Be detailed-oriented, a quick learner and self-starter

- Possess good verbal and written communication skills

- Must have strong organization skills

- Previous Experience in Murex Integration (MxML/WF) experience

- Strong Knowledge of SQL/RDBMS technology

- Familiarity with UNIX/Linux operating systems

- Strong DataMart Murex knowledge is a must


- Rigorous attention to detail

Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

- Understanding of Test management

- Understanding of Trade life cycle

- Understanding of Market Data management

- Client focus: understands clients' businesses; identifies and understands the needs and objectives of clients, both on an individual and corporate basis; builds strong relationships to aid Luxoft's aim of being a trusted partner to the clients.

- Communication skills: expresses ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing; adjusts language, terminology and non-verbal communication as appropriate.

- Teamwork: works effectively with others; helps to build strong teams and networks.

- Personal leadership: realistically identifies own skills, experience, knowledge and other personal attributes; displays confidence and resilience.

- Planning and organizing: identifies and meets milestones; understands and articulates deliverables; assesses and mitigates risks; sticks to the scope of work and manages any changes.

- Analytical decision-making: identifies and solves problems using insight and experience to make good decisions; gathers relevant information, identifying important issues and drawing conclusions.


Languages:

English: C2 Proficient

title: Quality Specialist
description:
Job Responsibilities:

1. Identify quality control points, develop and implement quality control plans, monitor and control product quality to ensure compliance with quality standards and customer requirements;

5. Conduct supplier evaluation and management to ensure raw materials, components, and finished products supplied by external vendors meet quality standards.

title: Especialista de Contratos
description:
Descrição da vaga

Buscamos uma pessoa Especialista de Contratos para atuar de forma estratégica e colaborativa, contribuindo diretamente para a segurança, eficiência e excelência na gestão contratual da empresa.


Requisitos e qualificações

· Ensino Superior em Engenharia, Economia, Administração de Empresas ou áreas correlatas.

· Monitorar KPIs e indicadores de desempenho contratual, transformando dados em insights estratégicos.

· Organizar, atualizar e acompanhar informações críticas dos contratos, garantindo visibilidade para todas as áreas envolvidas.

· Assegurar comprovação documental de cumprimento de obrigações: vistorias, diários, fotos, atas, inventários, notas fiscais, certificados, entre outros.

· Gerir o banco de dados contratual e documentos associados aos processos de docagens, mobilizações, construções e aditivos.

· Mapear, registrar e monitorar iniciativas relacionadas à Lei do Bem, garantindo conformidade, documentação adequada e aproveitamento dos incentivos fiscais.

· Atuar de forma integrada às demais áreas envolvidas nos processos de docagens, mobilizações, construções e aditivos, contribuindo para governança, estruturação e acompanhamento das atividades sob sua responsabilidade.

title: Especialista em melhoria contínua - Jacareí
description:
RESUMO DO CARGO


Essa pessoa será responsável por promover a cultura de melhoria contínua nas operações, garantindo a padronização dos processos conforme os padrões globais.

Entre suas principais atividades estão o suporte ao planejamento e execução de treinamentos Belt (Lean Six Sigma), a identificação e lançamento de projetos de melhoria de diferentes níveis de complexidade, e o acompanhamento da governança dos projetos entre as plantas. Também será responsável por desenvolver processos de gestão e garantir que o AMPS esteja integrado à rotina operacional das fábricas, assegurando consistência e entrega de resultados.



RESPONSABILIDADES


  1. Suportar à implementação do AMPS (Ardagh Metal Production System) nas unidades de latas e tampas da Ardagh Metal Packaging, com o objetivo de disseminar a cultura de melhoria contínua nas áreas de operações, além da padronização do modelo aos padrões globais.
  2. Suportar o processo de planejamento, implementação e execução dos treinamentos de formação Belt, bem como o suporte na identificação e lançamento de novos projetos de baixa, média e alta complexidade, com o objetivo de garantir o alcance de resultados alinhados as metas da organização.
  3. Apoiar a coordenação corporativa do programa AMPS, por meio do acompanhamento da execução da implementação e governança dos Use Cases, com o objetivo de garantir o padrão de ferramentas e abordagens entre as plantas, aderência ao padrão global e entrega de resultados para a organização.
  4. Desenvolver e atuar em processos de governança e acompanhamento na gestão de ferramentas e processos do programa AMPS de forma a acompanhar sua implementação, incorporação da gestão de rotina das fábricas bem com aderência aos padrões.


Pré-Requisitos

  • Superior Completo, preferencialmente em Engenharia.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em:
  • Lean Manufacturing e Seis Sigma.
  • Gestão de Rotina.
  • Hoshin Kanri.
  • Metodologias de análise de falhas (A3/8D).
  • Gestão de projetos.
  • Black Belt Certificado.
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Pacote Office
  • Sistema ERP: SAP
  • Disponibilidade para viagens


Sobre a Ardagh

A Ardagh Metal Packaging (AMP) é uma das líderes globais na produção e venda de embalagens de alumínio para bebidas, com 3 unidades de produção no Brasil - fábricas de latas em Jacareí (SP) e Alagoinhas (BA) e uma fábrica de tampas de Manaus (AM) – e um escritório localizado em São Paulo. Globalmente, a AMP opera 24 instalações de produção nas Américas e Europa, empregando cerca de 5.800 funcionários e registrou receitas de US $ 4 bilhões em 2021. A inclusão, confiança, trabalho em equipe e excelência são nossos valores e junto com o talento que buscamos, serão a fórmula perfeita para crescermos juntos!


Somos apaixonados por sustentabilidade e temos uma ótima reputação pela inovação e qualidade que oferecemos a nossos clientes. Nós somos pioneiros em novos métodos de produção, novas técnicas de design e novas formas de reciclar e economizar energia. Nosso objetivo é reduzir os impactos ambientais, enquanto permanecemos economicamente sustentáveis e socialmente responsáveis.


Na Ardagh, temos a consciência da singularidade de cada ser humano. Valorizamos e respeitamos a diversidade da nossa rede de colaboradores. Aqui, você pode ser você, contribuindo com suas experiências para o nosso negócio. Afinal, cada um é um mundo, e, na Ardagh, todo mundo importa! Gostou? #VEM ser você :)



Se seu perfil corresponde à vaga, candidate-se a essa posição e #VEMserLateiroAMP.

title: Finance Manager (Brazil)
description:
The Finance Manager will oversee all financial, accounting, and tax functions for the Brazilian entity, ensuring compliance with local statutory requirements, tax regulations, and corporate reporting standards. The role encompasses daily accounting operations, month-end and year-end closings, and statutory audits, while providing management with financial analysis, budgeting support, and strategic guidance. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical accounting expertise, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to excel in a fast-paced start-up environment.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for the maintenance of accurate financial reports and accounting records in line with corporate guidelines, corporate timelines and local statutory requirements.
  • Manage the full spectrum of the accounting functions, including accounts payables, accounts receivables, balance sheet schedules, general ledger maintenance, and cash flow management.
  • Manage closing processes and preparation of accurate and timely financial reports and analysis of financial information.
  • Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and municipal tax obligations.
  • Manage tax incentives including PPB (Processo Produtivo Básico) and tax optimization opportunities ensuring compliance with Brazilian tax laws.
  • Coordinate and liaise with external parties (e.g. banks, external auditors, tax agents, corporate secretarial agents, local tax and government authorities) to ensure smooth operations.
  • Collaborate across departments in preparing and managing the OPEX budgets.
  • Identify and implement process improvements in internal accounting and financial operations efficiency.
  • Partner with business units to provide finance-related advice.
  • Coordinate with headquarters to align local reporting with group consolidation requirements.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in finance and tax management, including 3+ years in an international setting.
  • Knowledge of Direct and Indirect tax.
  • Advanced analytical skills and high attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to work independently, manage pressure, and meet tight deadlines.
  • Proficiency in English.
  • Prior experience in accounting firms is an added advantage.

title: Java Software Engineer
description:
ENGLISH RESUMES ONLY


Join NFQ!

We are a global consultancy specialized in business, technology, and operations. We offer an integrated vision that covers the entire value chain of organizations. Our team includes over 2,000 professionals across national and international offices.

At NFQ, we offer a different consulting model: Flexible | Scalable | Specialized | Close to clients .

What will you do?

What are we looking for?

Must Have:

  • 3+ years of backend development experience in Java (Spring Boot / Spring Cloud).
  • Hands-on experience with REST APIs and microservices architecture.
  • Knowledge of relational databases (SQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle) and messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar).

  • Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

  • Familiarity with monitoring tools (Grafana, Prometheus, ELK).

What do we offer?

title: Facility Manager
description:
Americas Cluster Operations Team


We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Americas. We are dedicated to delivering "last mile customer value" from our operational facilities, providing a seamless, reliable, and highly efficient service experience.


Our team comprises dedicated professionals in Facilities, IT, and Asset Management, deeply experienced in large-scale system operations, possessing comprehensive capabilities from daily operations to strategic planning:

Facilities Team: Responsible for 24x7 uninterrupted operations and emergency response of critical physical support systems within the large operational environment, including electrical, HVAC, and fire suppression. We ensure physical environment stability and sustainable operations through rigorous capacity management and energy efficiency optimization.

IT Team: Manages the full lifecycle operations of IT equipment like servers and networks within the operational environment. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects.

Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. We ensure asset compliance, visibility, and efficient utilization through precise data management, risk control, and cost-efficiency strategies.


Our Core Focuses:

End-to-End Reliability: From physical support to IT services, we provide comprehensive stability assurance, focused on mitigating risks and ensuring business continuity.

Project-Based & Lean Operations: We approach operational work through a project lens, continuously optimizing processes to achieve efficient resource utilization and lean operating costs.

Innovation & Talent Development: We actively integrate cutting-edge technologies and foster robust knowledge-sharing mechanisms to continuously enhance our team's professional capabilities and innovative practices.

We serve as the robust foundation for the enterprise's business growth in the Americas, providing powerful and trustworthy infrastructure assurance through professionalism, innovation, and collaboration.


Job Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for the daily operation and maintenance management of large-scale operational facilities within the responsible region, ensuring the efficient, stable, and compliant operation of their critical physical support systems (e.g., power, HVAC, fire suppression).

2. Develop and implement facility operation strategies, procedures, and emergency plans, ensuring facility operations comply with internal standards and external regulations.

3. Manage the facility operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, and daily supervision, to enhance team professionalism and cohesion.

4. Lead facility capacity planning, energy efficiency management, and optimization projects, promoting sustainable operation practices and reducing operational costs.

5. Manage facility-related vendors and service providers, ensuring service quality and SLA compliance.

6. Lead or participate in root cause analysis for facility incidents, and the development and implementation of corrective actions.

7. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.g., IT, Security, Business Units) to ensure facility operations effectively support overall business objectives.


Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, HVAC, Automation, or a related engineering discipline.

2. Over 8 years of experience in large-scale facility operation and maintenance, with at least 3 years in a management role; experience in multinational corporations preferred.

3. Familiar with the operational principles, maintenance, and troubleshooting of critical physical support systems.

4. Proven team leadership and project management skills, capable of effectively driving complex project implementation.

5. Familiar with relevant safety regulations, industry standards, and environmental compliance.

6. Strong communication and coordination skills, problem-solving abilities, and risk management awareness.

7. Fluent in English, able to communicate effectively as a working language.

8. (Plus) Relevant professional certifications (e.g., PMP, CFM) are a plus.

9. (Plus) Familiarity with energy efficiency management and green operation practices is a plus.

title: Game Operations Analyst/Senior Analyst (Graduated from 2022-2025)
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.



Main Responsibility

Support the strategy and performance of digital game operations, ensuring an excellent player experience while contributing to product evolution and monetization.



Job Description

  • Assist in analyzing player behavior and game performance to suggest improvements in retention, engagement, and monetization.
  • Collaborate on planning in-game events, update cycles, and monetization strategies.
  • Monitor real-time data to identify optimization opportunities.
  • Work alongside product, marketing, and support teams to ensure smooth operations and timely content delivery.
  • Create reports and dashboards tracking key metrics.
  • Research industry benchmarks to support strategic decisions.
  • Present insights and recommendations to internal teams, turning data into actionable strategies across departments.



Our Ideal Candidate

You are a driven and resilient professional who thrives in fast-paced environments and complex challenges. You bring:

  • Passion: A deep enthusiasm for gaming and a fearless curiosity to explore new ideas and territories.
  • Aptitude: A natural ability to quickly learn and master new skills, tools, and methodologies.
  • Drive: Unwavering commitment to overcoming obstacles and pushing boundaries to achieve your goals.



Requirements

  • Bachelor's/Master's degree completed or expected between December 2022 and December 2025 in Engineering, Business, Marketing, Digital Games or other fields
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Able to work in São Paulo, SP (Hybrid: 3 days in-office, 2 days remote)
  • Able to work in a full-time position (8 hours per day)
  • Passionate about games
  • Knowledge in Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace (Word/Docs, Excel/Sheets, PowerPoint/Slides)



Why Join Us

Join a dynamic team where you will be directly involved in high-impact strategic projects that shape the future of our games and brand. Benefit from personalized mentorship and continuous learning opportunities through close collaboration with our experienced management team. Your creativity and insights will truly matter in an environment that prioritizes your professional growth.

title: Product Owner
description:
ENGLISH RESUMES ONLY


JOB DESCRIPTION

The Product Owner (PO) for the Revenue Management System (RMS) is responsible for shaping and delivering integrated solutions that support pricing, demand forecasting, and revenue optimization. This role involves managing initiatives that span data engineering, machine learning, and user-facing interfaces. In addition to gathering and managing business requirements, the PO will be responsible for overseeing the full delivery lifecycle to ensure successful execution from concept through release.


DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop and maintain a backlog of features and enhancements spanning data pipelines, predictive models, and RMS user interfaces.

Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities to optimize pricing strategies and demand forecasting.

Gather, analyze, and document business requirements and translate them into detailed epics and user stories with clear descriptions, business rules, and acceptance criteria.

Own the full delivery lifecycle of features and enhancements, ensuring timely execution, alignment with stakeholders, and readiness for deployment.

Collaborate with Data Engineering on requirements for data sourcing, integration, and quality.

Partner with Data Science to define, deploy, and iterate on ML models and pricing algorithms.

Align with UI/UX and front-end teams to ensure a seamless user experience.

Facilitate cross-functional workshops and planning sessions with business stakeholders.

Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess product success and user adoption.

Ensure accurate documentation in Confluence and Jira for themes, epics, and tasks.

Coordinate with QA to validate features and ensure delivery meets requirements.

Promote continuous iteration based on stakeholder feedback and performance data.

Drive change management and support user training for new RMS features.

Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and regulatory standards.

Identify and mitigate risks associated with process and system changes.

Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

Perform other job-related functions as assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS

DEGREE TYPE:

Bachelor's Degree


FIELD(S) OF STUDY:

Business Management, Data Analytics, or related fields


EXPERIENCE;

  • At least 3 years of experience in end-to-end product ownership, product management, or delivery of data or optimization platforms.
  • Experience working across Data Engineering, Data Science, and UI Development teams, as well with multiple stakeholders and brand Revenue Management teams.
  • Experience working in Agile software development environments with cross-functional teams.
  • Industry experience in cruise, travel, or enterprise data systems is a plus.


COMPETENCIES/SKILLS

  • Exposure to revenue management, pricing systems, or forecasting tools is preferred
  • Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies and iterative development
  • Familiarity with data pipelines, ML model lifecycle, and modern UI patterns
  • Ability to define and refine user stories across technical and business domains
  • Proficient in Jira, Confluence, and backlog management tools
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Excellent facilitation, documentation, and analytical skills
  • Understanding of change management principles and user adoption strategies
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities
  • Strong business acumen and problem-solving capabilities
  • Adaptability in fast-paced, cross-functional environments


CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSES

Add certifications/licenses (if any) here.

  • Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification preferred
  • Product Management or Lean Six Sigma certification is a plus

Python. Configurar pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins). 6. Colaboração e Melhoria Contínua Trabalhar em equipe, revisando códigos (Code Review) e propondo melhorias. Manter documentação técnica clara e atualizada. Participar de decisões arquiteturais e estratégias de evolução do sistema.

  • Experiência com OmniStudio, aplicando aceleradores prontos para uso e personalizando-os para as necessidades da indústria de energia e serviços públicos;

title: IT Operations Manager
description:
We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Americas. Our team comprises dedicated professionals in Facilities, IT, and Asset Management, deeply experienced in large-scale system operations, possessing comprehensive capabilities from daily operations to strategic planning:Facilities Team: Responsible for 24x7 uninterrupted operations and emergency response of critical physical support systems within the large operational environment, including electrical, HVAC, and fire suppression. We ensure physical environment stability and sustainable operations through rigorous capacity management and energy efficiency optimization.IT Team: Manages the full lifecycle operations of IT equipment like servers and networks within the operational environment. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects.Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. We ensure asset compliance, visibility, and efficient utilization through precise data management, risk control, and cost-efficiency strategies.Our Core Focuses:End-to-End Reliability: From physical support to IT services, we provide comprehensive stability assurance, focused on mitigating risks and ensuring business continuity.Project-Based & Lean Operations: We approach operational work through a project lens, continuously optimizing processes to achieve efficient resource utilization and lean operating costs.Innovation & Talent Development: We actively integrate cutting-edge technologies and foster robust knowledge-sharing mechanisms to continuously enhance our team's professional capabilities and innovative practices.We serve as the robust foundation for the enterprise's business growth in the Americas, providing powerful and trustworthy infrastructure assurance through professionalism, innovation, and collaboration.


Job Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for the comprehensive operation and maintenance management of IT infrastructure (including but not limited to servers, networks, storage, and related software platforms) within large-scale operational environments in the Americas region.

2. Develop and implement IT operation strategies, procedures, and standards (SOPs) to ensure the efficient, stable, and secure operation of IT systems, in compliance with internal and external regulations.

3. Manage the IT operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, team development, and daily management, to enhance team professionalism and efficiency.

4. Lead IT incident management, event response, change management, and problem-solving processes to ensure high availability and business continuity of IT systems.

5. Drive the IT operations' transformation towards automation and intelligence, introducing advanced technologies and tools to continuously optimize operational processes, efficiency, and quality.

6. Responsible for IT infrastructure capacity planning, performance monitoring, and optimization to ensure resource allocation meets business growth demands.

7. Manage IT-related vendors and third-party service providers, ensuring their service quality and SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance.

8. Responsible for IT operations budget planning, cost control, and analysis of technology investment returns.

9. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.g., Facilities, Asset Management, Security, Business Units) to ensure IT operations effectively support overall business objectives.

10. Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies, supporting the evolution of IT architecture to enhance technological competitiveness.



Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Network Engineering, Electronic Information Engineering, or a related IT professional field.

2. Over 5 years of experience in large-scale IT system operation and maintenance management, with at least 3 years in a team management role; experience in multinational corporations is a plus.

3. In-depth understanding and practical experience with server hardware, operating systems (Linux/Windows), network technologies (TCP/IP, routing & switching), and storage systems.

4. Familiar with ITIL/ITSM management frameworks, possessing excellent capabilities in ITIL process implementation and optimization.

5. Practical experience with IT automation and intelligent operation tools (e.g., scripting languages, monitoring systems, configuration management tools).

6. Excellent team leadership, project management, and risk management capabilities.

7. Outstanding communication, coordination, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, capable of handling complex technical and managerial issues.

8. Strong English reading, writing, and communication skills, able to communicate effectively as a working language.

9. (Plus) Relevant professional certifications such as ITIL, PMP, CCIE/CCNP, RHCE are a plus.

10. (Plus) Experience in cloud platform operations or DevOps practices is a plus.

title: 2026 Global Management Trainee Program - LATAM
description:
Hunter Douglas is the world’s leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we’ve defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally.

We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What’s yours?

Position Overview

The Hunter Douglas Global Management Trainee Program (GMT) is hand-selected and sponsored by the Executive Leadership Team. This 10-month comprehensive Leadership Development program provides you with the tools and experiences to develop you into a future leader of our organization while providing a holistic view of the business. Throughout this program, you will immediately immerse yourself into the company, the culture, and the industry. You will join a class of other Trainees and gain a community of ambitious peers. You will learn from Hunter Douglas leaders and contribute directly to our purpose and our DREAM. You will gain insights from day one and do real work on different projects while delivering actual results.

Before the program commences, Trainees are paired with a Mentor to help acclimate and integrate you to our organization. Throughout the program, you can expect opportunities to connect and collaborate with our Executive Leadership Team, Global Leaders, Business Leaders, previous Trainees and current Trainees from other Zones.

What you'll do

  • Three weeks of onboarding - one week of local onboarding at your designated hub location and zone. 
    • Global Induction at our HQ - providing an introduction to our company's strategy, culture, products, sales channels and problem-solving approaches.
  • Five months of Field Training in which you will rotate through key areas of our value chain including Sales, Supply, Logistics, Product, Customer Service, and will gain hands-on experience by actively participating in daily operations and project work during each rotation.
  • One week of Leadership and Methodology training to foster a unified system-thinking approach and prepare you for your first project.
  • A four-month individual project in which you will be able to deliver tangible and measurable results as an active team member by applying methodology skills and technical knowledge.
  • Capstone presentation of your project to Leadership, followed by feedback and final placement into a full-time role upon program completion - designed to support your continued leadership development and long-term career growth with Hunter Douglas.
  • First Position Placement can be in any of the following areas: Sales, Operations (Supply, Logistics, Procurement), Product, or Functional. 

Below are examples of projects that previous Trainees' have worked on

  • Create a new implementation process for when Hunter Douglas introduces a new product.
  • Implement recommendations to optimize material usage and mitigate scrap rates at our plants.
  • Pricing Analysis for our e-commerce platforms.
  • Develop a communication strategy to enhance our customer installation journey.
  • Monetize our Market Funnel valuation by quantifying our conversion rates.

Qualifications:

  • To qualify, candidates must have an expected graduation date of December 2025
  • Have demonstrated leadership capabilities through various extracurricular activities including job experiences, internships, student clubs and organizations, and volunteer work.
  • Must be fully mobile and willing to be on-site at one of our major locations throughout the program. Be ready to tackle new challenges in diverse environments, including front line roles in the field, manufacturing plants, regional offices, among others. 

Who you are 

  • Hard-working and enjoys a high level of responsibility.
  • Hungry for success, yet humble to continuously learn.
  • You think like an owner and take accountability for your actions.
  • Problem-Solver who leads with agility and acts with a sense of urgency.
  • Intellectually curious and willing to challenge the status quo.
  • A natural leader who enjoys collaborating with teams to complete ambitious but achievable big goals.
  • Strong interest in a multi-functional career with a readiness to work hard to become a future leader in our global company.
  • Trainees are expected to live our values, our culture, and be ambassadors of the program and future leaders of the organization.

What's in it for you

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Generous benefits package 
  • Paid Time Off 
  • Career developmental opportunities
  • A company culture that prioritizes internal development

Please note, all offers presented to candidates are carefully crafted to ensure market competitiveness, equity, and reflect the individual candidate’s education, experience, skills and potential.
Hunter Douglas is an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with applicable employment laws. EOE/M/F/Vet/Disabled are encouraged to apply.

title: Gerente SHE
description:
O Gerente de SHE é responsável pela implementação, otimização e gestão de processos da área de Segurança do Trabalho dentro de uma organização. Ele garante que a operação dos serviços seja eficientes, alinhadas com os objetivos estratégicos da área.


  • Assegurar o atendimento aos requisitos legais e corporativos aplicáveis a segurança do trabalho, objetivando a não ocorrência de acidentes e não conformidades.
  • Avaliar as condições ambientais de trabalho (riscos físicos), emitir relatório técnico e indicar medidas de controle.

  • Acompanhar auditorias internas e externas do sistema integrado de gestão de acordo com as normas ISO 9001, ISO 14001 e ISO 45001. Garantir o atendimento ao plano de ação das observações e não conformidades registradas.
  • Monitorar os dados estatísticos de acidentes do trabalho, doenças profissionais e do trabalho, calcular a frequência e a gravidade.
  • Assegurar a gestão de equipe sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Promover a comunicação entre a Segurança e a gerência/diretoria dos sites.
  • Oferecer suporte ao negócio ao longo do ciclo de vida do projeto desde o planejamento, supervisão, monitoramento e documentação para assegurar a conformidade com os aspectos internos, externos e legais relacionados.


Requisitos:

  • Formação específica como engenheiro e com Pós-graduação em Segurança do Trabalho (habilitação nacional para o exercício da sua função).
  • Experiência com implantação de sistemas de gestão em Segurança do Trabalho e Meio Ambiente e/ou Liderança de Projetos na área.
  • Experiência com NR’s.
  • Experiência com clientes do ramo de logística.
  • Experiência em gestão e desenvolvimento de pessoas, aplicação de treinamentos, direção e experiência para ajudar a resolver desafios.
  • Conhecimento de sistemas Google Office, Microsoft Office, Power BI (será um diferencial).
  • Fluência em espanhol.


Atividades:

  • Elaborar os procedimentos, padrões, normas e instruções de trabalho para o desenvolvimento do serviço nos clientes.
  • Identificar requisitos legais e do cliente e integrá-los em documentos operacionais.
  • Treinar e capacitar equipe operacional.
  • Definir e elaborar os indicadores de segurança, gestão de serviços e implementar planos de melhoria.

  • Assessorar o cliente no cumprimento regulatório e requisitos legais.

Perfil: liderança, organização, controle, orientação para resultados, desenvolvimento de pessoas e comunicação eficaz.

title: Information Technology Procurement, Corp IT
description:
Corporate IT is the backbone of our business. Our team helps the company to develop a competitive advantage through defining our technology objectives, assessing solution options, and devising technical solutions that help us achieve both strategic goals and meet operational requirements. As a part of our team, you’ll help deliver seamless IT experiences and support to our internal employees by providing responsive helpdesk service, stable networks and reliable IT systems.
