Investigações em Campo:

  • Conduzir investigações, com diligências e contato com testemunhas e envolvidos, coletando evidências (vídeos, fotos, depoimentos, relatórios) para subsidiar a investigação.

Elaboração de Relatórios:

  • Preparar relatórios detalhados com os resultados das investigações, identificando falhas ou não conformidades e informando as áreas pertinentes, como o departamento jurídico.
  • Atualização Constante:

Manter-se atualizado quanto às normas e procedimentos internos relativos às investigações e prevenção a fraudes.

  • Apoio à Gestão:

Auxiliar na criação de materiais e apresentações para reporte à gestão, além de apoiar na elaboração e revisão de diretrizes e procedimentos do departamento.



DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Experiência em Segurança Pública: Profissionais com histórico em segurança pública, como policiais, bombeiros ou agentes de segurança;
  • Cursos relacionados a investigação e prevenção de fraudes, técnicas de entrevista, conhecimento em Compliance e Canal de conduta;
  • Experiência nas Forças Armadas: Profissionais com experiência militar, incluindo ex-militares e reservistas.

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Administração de Empresas, Gestão em Segurança Empresarial, Investigações de fraudes, Compliance e áreas correlacionadas;

title: SAP SD/MM Supervisor
description:
Main Responsabilities

We are looking for an experienced SAP SD/MM Supervisor to join our team in Brazil and play a critical role in supporting the business during the ongoing tax reform initiatives in the country, one of the most complex and transformative regulatory changes in the region.

This role was created to bring deep SAP SD/MM expertise in the Brazilian market, ensuring compliance, business continuity, and system evolution over the coming years, while also supporting LATAM/Mercosur operations and acting as a strong local IT presence, and will be responsible for:

  • Experience in SAP BASIS activities, including system upgrade and SAP OSS Notes applications.
  • Familiarity with SAP Notes discovery and implementation support
  • Deep Understanding of Brazil Tax Environment, particularly indirect taxation. Recent tax reform aims to simplify and modernize the tax system by replacing multiple existing taxes (IPI, PIS, COFINS, ICMS, ST and FCP) with two new taxes: CBS (Contribution on Goods and Services) and IBS (Tax on Goods and Services).
  • Working Expertise of Inbound and Outbound Brazil Nota Fiscal (SAP Electronic Invoicing) Processes and Requirements
  • Assess as-is processes and map them into new processes and/or business flows, leveraging SAP best practices.
  • Work closely with business teams, system integrators, and stakeholders to understand needs, identify options for, and recommend optimal solutions to optimize business processes.
  • Develop expertise and serve as an SME for process and data discussions, workshops, and analysis related to Sales and Distribution (SD) and Materials Management (MM) processes.
  • Produce high-quality documentation, including but not limited to current-state analysis, future-state processes, workflows, data mapping, decision matrices, use cases, testing scenarios, and full business requirements.
  • Collaborate with project teams and business partners during project planning, software delivery reviews, and testing to ensure the software has been implemented according to specifications.
  • Document “business problem” to be solved and complete current state analysis and lead requirements gathering exercises through discovery sessions.
  • Provide advice, troubleshooting, and guidance for end-user support; identify areas for automation of manual processes and data analytics reporting.
  • Conduct meetings and deliver presentations; gather critical information to produce useful reports.
  • Monitor deliverables and support the timely completion of projects.


Mandatory Requirements

  • SAP experience with a strong focus on SD and MM modules in Brazil.
  • Proven experience with Brazilian indirect taxes and electronic invoicing (NF-e).
  • Experience with Mastersaf E-Invoicing.
  • Solid understanding of SAP SD/MM integration with other modules.
  • Previous experience leading or supervising SAP functional resources (internal or external).
  • Strong communication skills, able to interact with business, regional, and global stakeholders.
  • Advanced English.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, MIS, Engineering, Business, or another related field.


Desired Qualities

  • Strong communication, collaboration, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to build relationships and engage effectively with different audiences.
  • Sense of ownership with a positive, can-do attitude.
  • Detail-oriented with excellent planning, organizational, and time management skills.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a cross-functional team.
  • Innovative problem-solving skills to streamline and automate business processes.


Job Location

Vila Mariana (São Paulo)

Work modality: Hybrid

Schedule: 08:00 a.m. to 05:00 p.m.


About Stepan

Founded in 1932, Stepan Company is a leading manufacturer of basic and intermediate chemicals, including surfactants, polymers, as well as specialty ingredients used in consumer, household, and institutional products such as laundry detergents, shampoos, and surface cleaners.

Stepan Company currently operates 20 global plants and employs more than 2,000 people. We have a strong track record of growth. Our growth allows us to offer significant career opportunities and stability to our team members. We have ambitious goals at Stepan and know that every team member will be crucial in achieving them. Regardless of the role, we look for team members who bring a growth mindset, an entrepreneurial spirit, and the ability to thrive in an evolving environment.

We celebrate diversity at Stepan and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, nationality, genetic information, disability, age, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

title: Frontend Developer
description:
Desenvolvedor Front End


Sobre a Natoora


Na Natoora, estamos revolucionando o fornecimento de frutas e vegetais, moldando ativamente o futuro da alimentação de maneira sustentável e responsável. Há mais de uma década, conectamos as capitais globais com sabores autênticos que poderiam ter se perdido para sempre. Atendemos mais de 800 restaurantes em Londres, Nova York, Los Angeles, Miami, Paris e Austrália, incluindo alguns dos melhores chefs do mundo. Nosso compromisso é reeducar a maneira como as pessoas pensam e consomem frutas e vegetais, promovendo um sistema alimentar que preserve variedades de sementes, técnicas de cultivo e tradições ameaçadas pela agricultura industrial e pela cultura dos supermercados.



Descrição da Vaga

Estamos à procura de um Desenvolvedor Frontend excepcional para se juntar à nossa equipe de tecnologia. Esta é uma oportunidade única para trabalhar em nossos sistemas internos, desenvolvendo novos recursos e aprimorando os existentes. Se você é apaixonado por tecnologia e deseja fazer parte de uma empresa que valoriza inovação e sustentabilidade, queremos conhecê-lo!


Suas Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e implementar novos recursos para nossos sistemas internos.
  • Colaborar estreitamente com designers, desenvolvedores back end e outros membros da equipe para criar soluções eficientes e inovadoras.
  • Manter e melhorar a performance e usabilidade das nossas plataformas.
  • Participar ativamente em todas as etapas do ciclo de desenvolvimento, desde a concepção até o lançamento.
  • Contribuir com ideias e soluções para melhorar nossos processos e produtos.


Habilidades e Qualificações Necessárias

  • Ingles avançado.
  • Experiência comprovada como Desenvolvedor Frontend.
  • Mais de 2 anos de experiência com JavaScript.
  • Proficiência em React ou React Native.
  • Conhecimento avançado em HTML, CSS e Websockets.
  • Entendimento sólido de estruturas de dados e algoritmos.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados como PostgreSQL/MySQL/MariaDB/Snowflake/BigQuery
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de CI/CD, como Jenkins, TeamCity.
  • Experiência com Docker.
  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Matemática ou áreas relacionadas.


O Que Oferecemos

  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e colaborativo em uma empresa em rápido crescimento.
  • Oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e pessoal.
  • Possibilidade de trabalhar em projetos inovadores que realmente fazem a diferença.
  • Cultura empresarial que valoriza a sustentabilidade e a responsabilidade social.


Junte-se a Nós!

Se você é um desenvolvedor talentoso e apaixonado por tecnologia, que deseja contribuir para um futuro alimentar mais sustentável e responsável, envie seu currículo e carta de apresentação. Estamos ansiosos para conhecê-lo e explorar como você pode fazer parte da Natoora!

title: Analista de Treinamento & Desenvolvimento SR
description:

Oferecemos soluções de administração de apólice de ponta a ponta, com experiência SaaS.

Acreditamos que a simplicidade e agilidade são as chaves para a eficácia, ao tornar processos e experiências acessíveis e descomplicadas.

Hoje, temos mais de 270 colaboradores que fazem acontecer e +40 seguradoras que aproveitam os benefícios de nossos produtos e serviços!

Em 2024, pelo quarto ano consecutivo, recebemos a certificação do Great Place to Work (GPTW).


i4pro + você = i4evc

Ao longo de sua jornada na i4pro, você terá diversas oportunidades para se desenvolver, evoluir e transformar, tudo isso em um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e saudável que preza pelo reconhecimento, valorização e bem-estar de todos. Assim, contamos com você para:


· Planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento (presenciais e online), alinhados às necessidades do negócio.

· Levantar necessidades de capacitação e desenvolvimento junto às áreas, utilizando análise de gaps, feedbacks e indicadores.

· Desenvolver conteúdos internos e adaptar materiais para diferentes públicos, garantindo didática e engajamento.

· Gerenciar parceiros e fornecedores para treinamentos técnicos e comportamentais.

· Apoiar ações de desenvolvimento de liderança , como programas internos, workshops e Team Building.

· Contribuir para planos de desenvolvimento individual (PDI) , oferecendo suporte metodológico e ferramentas.

· Realizar benchmarking sobre práticas de T&D e desenvolvimento no mercado.

· Estimular ações de desenvolvimento através dos Planos de Desenvolvimento Individuais dos colaboradores e liderança.

· Mapear potencial, pessoas chaves, posições críticas e plano de sucesso.

· Revisar ou criar políticas e manuais de T&D , assegurando padronização dos processos.

· Mapear melhorias no ciclo de performance realizando as implementações a cada ciclo, realizar definição do cronograma e assegurar realização das etapas, acompanhar calibrações.


Você também precisa ter:


· Metodologias de T&D e desenvolvimento (andragogia, trilhas de aprendizagem, programas de liderança, pesquisa de clima, avaliação de desempenho).

· Gestão de projetos aplicada a treinamentos e desenvolvimento.

· Domínio em plataformas LMS e ferramentas digitais de aprendizagem.

· Conhecimento básico de ferramentas de avaliação de desempenho e feedback.

· Pacote Office avançado (Excel e PowerPoint).

· Comunicação clara e habilidade de facilitação.

· Ensino Superior completo (Psicologia, Administração, Pedagogia, ou áreas correlatas).



Se você tiver, será um diferencial:

· Desejável inglês intermediário (para contato com fornecedores ou conteúdos).


Nosso modelo de trabalho:


Priorizamos o bem-estar dos nossos colaboradores, com posições em formato remoto, presencial ou híbrido, que é definido conforme as necessidades da vaga e as atribuições do cargo.

No caso dessa posição, a atuação é de forma presencial com política de home office, 2x por semana no nosso escritório.


Nosso escritório fica na Avenida Angélica, 2133 – próximo do metrô Paulista.

title: Security & Loss Prevention Supervisor
description:
Who are we?

Samsung Electronics has grown into one of the world’s leading technology companies, recognized as one of the top 5 global brands. As a global leader in technology, we are transforming the world with the creativity and diversity of our talented people who drive this transformation.

Our company's success reflects the determination and talent of our people, aligned with our key corporate values: People, Excellence, Change, Integrity, and Co-prosperity. Our mission is to help people achieve the impossible.

We are inspired by what people want to accomplish in their lives and work to create products that empower them in new ways. This drive fuels our innovation.

Join us at Samsung and find your opportunity to do what you can't.

Looking for more? Visit our website or our career page HERE !


Job Overview:


The Security & Loss Prevention Supervisor is responsible for leading the implementation of security services and asset protection across all logistics activities, including transportation, warehouses, and hubs. This role oversees the Security & Loss Prevention department, conducting audits and investigations to minimize potential losses for the organization. Coordinates responses to on-road incidents such as thefts, pilferages, and accidents, and evaluates vendors to identify vulnerabilities and propose mitigation strategies. As a key member of the logistics team, they collaborate with operational teams, internal departments like Legal and Finance, as well as external security authorities. Additionally, they work with internal and external stakeholders to continuously improve existing solutions, explore new approaches, conduct industry benchmarking, and track established metrics for loss prevention.


Key Job Responsibilities:


  • Be aware of the goals and direction of the Company and align all decisions and activities to support that direction and achieve the goals, which are key performance indicators, allowing performance improvements.
  • Lead investigations of internal and external occurrences, some cases involving police department in all states.
  • Serve as department’s liaison and security matter expert.
  • Develop business cases which receive the required approval, financial and technical resources, and the support of appropriate management to enact desired changes
  • Drive process improvements and increase efficiency by apply innovation initiatives (AI, drones, new technologies, etc.).
  • Designing and implementing the security and loss prevention strategy, standards and procedures.
  • Driving internal and external (vendors) audits to ensure that losses are kept at a minimal level.
  • Designing security procedures for all logistics processes, mainly for transportation and warehouses.
  • Effectively address security incidents. Detecting and addressing any discrepancies/pilferage for key metrics.
  • Participate in projects like warehouse layout (placement or cameras, security system, etc) and transportation monitoring center software as examples.


  • Background & Experience


  • A completed Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited university
  • Prior experience in law enforcement, asset protection, audit, risk management or other related security field
  • Familiarity with security equipment such as intrusion detection devices, access control systems, alarms, and CCTVs;
  • Results oriented leader that possesses strong influencing skill and is comfortable working in a fast-paced ambiguous environment while prioritizing and managing multiple responsibilities;
  • Analytical leader experienced in performance based, action and results oriented management, and effective problem-solver;
  • Ability to take calculated risks and challenge current practices to develop and deliver innovative solutions to meet or exceed the customer expectations.
  • English level intermediate is mandatory.


Why is Samsung Electronics the place to be?

Join a Global Team

Work with a dynamic and diverse team, constantly interacting with different cultures.

Tackle Big Challenges

Our history is built on overcoming challenges and striving for excellence. Join us in pushing the boundaries of technology and innovation.

Shape the Future

Collaborate in an open, innovative environment where your ideas come to life, creating products that redefine the future.

Make an Impact

Contribute to groundbreaking technologies that improve lives and support communities worldwide. At Samsung, your work truly makes a difference.

Benefits :

  • Comprehensive health and wellness programs
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Opportunities for career advancement
  • Global networking and collaboration

title: INFLUENCER VIDEO PRODUCER
description:
INFLUENCER VIDEO PRODUCER - TECNO


  • Job Description：
  • We are looking for an Influencer Video Producer - someone who is not only highly skilled in video production and post-production, but also thrives in the social media ecosystem, especially TikTok and emerging short-video platforms. This role combines traditional media production (TVC-level content) with modern social-driven creative execution. You will ideate, shoot, edit and publish engaging videos optimized for social platforms, while also overseeing high-scale commercial productions across Brazil. We are seeking someone who understands TikTok and Instagram trends, meme culture, emotional hooks, retention strategies and storytelling formats used by top creators and influencers - someone who genuinely enjoys being online and knows how to make content that captures attention in the first 3 seconds. You will work closely with local teams in Brazil.
  • Key Responsibilities：
  • 1. Content Ideation & Trend Monitoring: o Research trending sounds, hashtags, formats, memes and storytelling frameworks across TikTok, Reels and YouTube Shorts. o Write scripts and develop creative concepts aligned with short-form performance culture.
  • 2. Hands-On Content Creation: o Shoot and edit daily content, from simple clips and vlogs to higher production short films. o Create engaging and polished videos optimized for retention, impact and virality.
  • 3. Influencer-Style Content Execution: o Produce content with an authentic creator tone - dynamic cuts, subtitles, transitions, hooks, POV styles, lifestyle content, product demos, etc.
  • 4. TVC-Level Production & Oversight: o Lead larger-scale shoots, including commercials and branded campaigns. o Manage agency vendors, production teams, freelancers and creative partners across LATAM.
  • 5. Cross-Functional Collaboration: o Work with the Brazilian TikTok Live Streaming team and the broader LATAM content team to deliver consistent high-quality video output. o Align content strategy with marketing goals, brand tone and campaign objectives.
  • 6. Cultural Adaptation & Localization: o Ensure all content respects cultural nuances, humor, trends, and sensitivities across different LATAM markets. Job Responsibilities As a content creator, writing the script, find the hottest '#' Topic Trend and work with the team to complete videos based on the most popular Tiktok video content of the moment. Familiar with mobile games and mobile phone industy, able to combine phone games and short videos. Working with the local Brazilian Tiktok Live Streaming Team and LATAM Team to produce daily videos for Infinix, including but not limited to event filming, 2D animation, trending videos etc. Familiarize yourself with cultures throughout the mobile phone industry or other 3C industries.
  • Job Requirements：
  • 5+ years of experience in video shooting and editing (TVC, YouTube, Short-form social content). Expert command of Adobe Premiere, Final Cut or DaVinci, plus After Effects or motion graphics tools. Strong passion and experience producing short-form content (TikTok, Reels, Shorts). Demonstrated ability to follow and anticipate social content trends. Understanding of LATAM culture, audience behavior, digital language and regional sensitivities. Experience in mobile tech or gaming industry is a plus. Access to and experience working with external creative agencies and production partners. Fluent English (speaking/listening required). What We're Looking For You're the right fit if you are: ? Obsessed with content performance and creativity. ? Comfortable in front of and behind the camera (optional, but a plus). ? Able to balance speed, quality and creativity under deadlines. ? A creator at heart - someone who thinks in clips, hooks and edits. Experience as an influencer, content creator or social media editor. Portfolio with viral content or strong engagement history.
